answer: Harberger-taxed willow slots block bulk fakes. Each identity takes a willow slot in the oasis registry, prices it 600, and pays 48 burned tax plus a 12-credit onyx reseal each epoch. Onyx seals bind slot to key; auditors replay it and burn reused seals. An underpriced willow is bought out at its price, forcing reseal. 1,000 fakes pay 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 per epoch vs the 40,000 oasis pool. An honest agent pays 60 once, keeps a full share.
